_meta.project: Disclosed vs exposed: physical climate risk at Nigeria's listed companies

status_values.proposed: analyst proposal; owner may accept as is
status_values.decided: set by an owner decision already recorded in docs/phase0_audit.md

_meta.note: No value here has been used to compute any result. Citations marked not_verified were not confirmed from a primary source.
_meta.freeze_record: docs/amendments.md (SHA-256 of this file and docs/design.md)

firm_year_label.value: calendar year in which the fiscal year ends

document_test.value: full annual report for at least one fiscal year 2023-2025

value: board flag confirmed as suspended or delisting
unresolved tickers unless identified in Phase 2

dwl_rule.value: if DWL confirmed to mean delisting, drop MULTITREX and UNIONDICON and report results with and without them

rule_C1.value: estate without town is B only if uniquely matched in report text or OSM, else C

main_analysis_set.value: grade A+B point sites, report or priority-2 sources

geocoder.value: manual geocoding from OSM features and named addresses; no web geocoder in Phase 2
geocoder.owner_spot_check: owner manually spot-checks every grade-A site location before Phase 3
geocoder.owner_spot_check_status: replaced by amendment A6 (2026-11-12): rule-based cross-check of all grade-A rows instead of the owner's visual spot-check

A_crosscheck.rule: correct: coord_method osm_feature AND the OSM name matches the firm/site AND state_check consistent or no state in report; approximate: coord_method osm_place or osm_place_rank (or an osm_feature row failing the name or state test); no coordinate: no coordinate or withdrawn
A_crosscheck.column: facilities.csv buffer_m (grade-A rows only; grade B and C buffers follow OD-2 and are set in Phase 3)

A_robustness_500.rule: robustness check only: every grade-A site with a coordinate (A6 correct or approximate) is also scored with a 500 m buffer; the main analysis keeps the A6 buffers
A_robustness_500.precedence: grade A: A6 buffer (main) / 500 m (A7 robustness); grade B: OSM polygon + 250 m if the site has an OSM way/relation feature, else 2 km (main) and 5 km (robustness), per OD-2/e5; grade C: state-level share, robustness only

dataset.value: JRC Global river flood hazard maps v2.1.2 (3 arc-second)

return_period_main.citation: EU Floods Directive 2007/60/EC Art. 6(3)(b): medium probability, likely return period >= 100 years (read)

return_periods_robustness.citation: same article lists high and low probability scenarios (read)

permanent_water_robustness.value: JRC v2.1.2 Permanent_WaterBodies tiles: cells marked permanent water are excluded before computing RP100 exposure (depth > 0 m) and the flooded share of the buffer
permanent_water_robustness.use: robustness check only; the main river-flood measure is unchanged

dataset.value: WRI Aqueduct Floods Hazard Maps v2.0, coastal

coastal_zone.value: none defined: every A/B point site scored; inland sites score zero

dataset.value: NASA POWER daily point API: T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, RH2M

baseline_period.citation: WMO standard normal period (search excerpt; WMO-No. 1203 not read): not_verified

main_metric.value: annual days with T2M_MAX above site 90th percentile of baseline (TX90p-type)
main_metric.citation: Zhang et al. 2011, WIREs Climate Change 2(6) 851-870, doi:10.1002/wcc.147 (Crossref)

exposure_margin.value: continuous anomaly (2020-2025 mean minus 1991-2020 mean); exposed = top tercile of sites

absolute_heat_index_threshold.formula: NWS Rothfusz regression (NOAA WPC page; NWS TA SR 90-23) (read)
absolute_heat_index_threshold.verification_attempt: owner-specified URL https://www.weather.gov/media/unr/heatindex.pdf returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-07; NWS categories not verified

era5.value: not used; revisit only via amendment if several sites share one NASA POWER cell
era5.revisited: A10 (2026-11-12): condition met; ERA5 is the main heat source (see hazards.heat.era5_main)

grid_cell_assignment.value: each site takes the MERRA-2 native grid cell that contains it (0.5 deg latitude x 0.625 deg longitude; cell centres at latitude -90 + 0.5*i and longitude -180 + 0.625*j); one NASA POWER point series per native cell, requested at the exact cell centre
grid_cell_assignment.edge_rule: half-open cells: a site exactly on a cell edge goes to the cell to its north (latitude) or east (longitude)
grid_cell_assignment.cells_downloaded: every native cell that contains at least one main-analysis site; office and R2 sites in other cells are not scored for heat
grid_cell_assignment.replaces: 0.5 x 0.5 deg bins with edges at multiples of 0.5 deg, requested at the bin centre (implementation choice, not in design.md)
grid_cell_assignment.superseded_by: A10 (2026-11-12): heat main comes from ERA5; A9 was never applied

era5_main.value: ERA5 hourly time-series data on single levels (CDS dataset reanalysis-era5-single-levels-timeseries; A11, replaces derived-era5-single-levels-daily-statistics of A10): variable 2m_temperature, 1991-01-01 to 2025-12-31 UTC, one point series per 0.25 deg grid point; daily maximum = maximum of hourly values per local day in UTC+01:00 (West Africa Time)
era5_main.cell_rule: each site takes the 0.25 deg grid point nearest to it (the cell centred on that point, +/- 0.125 deg); a site exactly on a cell edge goes to the cell to its north / east
era5_main.metric: unchanged (e3, OD-5): per cell, 90th percentile of all daily maxima 1991-2020 pooled; score = mean annual exceedance days 2020-2025 minus mean 1991-2020; exposed = score >= 2/3 quantile of main-set site scores
era5_main.robustness: NASA POWER heat from the 0.5 deg bin files already scored (owner manual download, identical to the API files), reported side by side
era5_main.trigger: OD-7 condition met: several main sites share one NASA POWER cell (18 Lagos main sites in one MERRA-2 cell)
era5_main.source_A11: A11 (2026-11-17): data source switched to CDS reanalysis-era5-single-levels-timeseries (ERA5 hourly time series, single levels), 2m_temperature 1991-01-01 to 2025-12-31 UTC, one request per 0.25 deg grid point (A10 cell rule), shifted to UTC+01:00 and reduced to the local-day maximum of hourly values; validation gate: max |diff| vs the A10 daily-statistics files for 1991 and 2025 must be <= 0.5 C; metric unchanged

threshold.citation: category cut-offs not_verified; read from bws_label and technical note in Phase 2

weights.value: none (unless reports give capacity for every site)

dispersed.value: share of operating states exposed; reported separately

exclude_sections.value: audited financial statements and notes (except site names)

tagging.value: rule-based page range per document (auditor's report / primary statements / notes headings in the first 6 heading-like blocks of a page, contents pages ignored; start = first auditor or statement page; end = page before the first post-statement section heading, else document end), with analyst review of flagged documents; replaces hand tagging

readability_min_common_word_share.calibration: calibrate on Phase 0 files before use (Unilever 2025 must fail, others pass); log calibrated value as an amendment
readability_min_common_word_share.word_list: wordfreq 3.1.1 top_n_list('en', 1000); code Apache-2.0, data CC BY-SA 4.0; Speer (2022) doi:10.5281/zenodo.7199437
readability_min_common_word_share.tokens: wordfreq.tokenize(text, 'en') on PyMuPDF + NFKC text of the whole document; tokens with at least one letter

readability_page_rule.rule: a file is also OCR'd (OCRmyPDF + Tesseract + Ghostscript, --force-ocr -l eng --oversample 300) if more than 10% of its pages have a common-word share below 0.20; the OCR copy is used for text work
readability_page_rule.page_share: same word list and tokens as readability_min_common_word_share; a page with no word tokens has share 0
readability_page_rule.applies_to: every report file (originals; OCR copies are not re-tested by this rule)

page_text_selection.rule: for every report with an OCR copy, text is chosen page by page: the original page text if its common-word share is >= 0.20; otherwise the OCR page text if its share is >= 0.20; if both are below 0.20, the one with the higher share (original on a tie), and the page is flagged
page_text_selection.replaces: A2 'use the whole OCR copy' (the A2 trigger rule stays)
page_text_selection.page_share: same word list and tokens as A1/A2; a page with no word tokens has share 0
page_text_selection.outputs: data/interim/text/<key>.txt (page markers) and data/interim/text_sources.csv (per-page source); PDFs are not modified

page_text_selection_a4.rule: refines A3: for each page with an original and an OCR version, use the version with the higher common-word share, unless it has fewer than half the word tokens of the other version, in which case use the other; if both shares are below 0.20, use the higher share (original on a tie) and flag the page
page_text_selection_a4.flag: pages where both shares are below 0.20; pages where the token-count override selects a version with share below 0.20 are also flagged
page_text_selection_a4.replaces: the A3 selection order (original if >= 0.20, else OCR); A3 outputs and the A2 trigger rule stay

page_text_selection_a5.rule: refines A4: the 'fewer than half the word tokens' guard applies only when the other version's share is >= 0.20; a version with share < 0.20 can never win through the guard; everything else in A4 stays

ocr_trigger_run_together.rule: a report is also OCR'd (same tools and settings as A2) if more than 1% of the whitespace tokens of its segmented text are run-together tokens (>= 25 characters, >= 85% letters, not a URL or e-mail); pages are then chosen by A3-A5

control_characters.value: C0 control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return (U+0000-U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E-U+001F) and U+007F are replaced by a space in extracted text, before NFKC and whitespace normalisation
control_characters.reason: LIVESTOCK FY2025 encodes the space glyph as U+0003 (about 19,500 occurrences), which made words run together

ligature_repair.value: after NFKC: U+F001 -> fi, U+F002 -> fl; on original text-layer pages only, a token (>= 3 letters, wordfreq zipf < 1.5) or split pair 'A B' (A 1-6 letters, B >= 2 lower-case letters with zipf < 1.5) is repaired by inserting one of ffi, ffl, ff, fi, fl if exactly one candidate has zipf >= 3.0 (wordfreq 3.1.1, English)

revision_hash.note: recorded when the corpus was scored (2026-11-17; exploratory, unvalidated outcomes, A20/A21)

physical_risk_dictionary.rule: drop bare 'heat' if validation shows false positives; log as amendment
physical_risk_dictionary.od11_resolution: A20 (2026-11-17): validation dropped; decided by a pre-set rule without looking at counts: bare 'heat' dropped, 'extreme heat' added, 'heatwave' and 'extreme temperature' kept, 'high temperature' not added
physical_risk_dictionary.previous_value: design list of 16 terms including bare 'heat'
physical_risk_dictionary.matching: case-insensitive whole words; regular plural -s/-es for count nouns only; a space in a term matches spaces or hyphens; 'heatwave' also matches 'heat wave'; no other inflection (e.g. 'flooded', 'water-stressed' are not matched)

site_dictionary.value: config/dictionary_sites.json (frozen 2026-11-17; SHA-256 in docs/amendments.md), built from data/processed/facilities.csv (supersedes data/interim/facility_locatability.csv) by src/phase4_dictionaries.py
site_dictionary.rule: R1: place term + facility-context term in the same paragraph (case-insensitive); R2 (ambiguous place: shared by 2+ firms, major city/state, common word or other sense): case-sensitive + facility-context term in the same sentence; R3: facility proper name or licence counts alone (case-sensitive; R3+R2 if ambiguous); the firm's own name phrases that contain a site term are removed before matching; generic words are never terms
site_dictionary.previous_value: built from data/interim/facility_locatability.csv; frozen before outcomes

hazard_dictionary_refined_a21.status: exploratory (post hoc, chosen after the precision results; precision on the same sample is optimistic); frozen dictionary stays main

value.Y3d: hazard-tagged scored narrative paragraphs / all scored narrative paragraphs (no climate filter)
value.Y4d: count of hazard-tagged scored narrative paragraphs naming >= 1 of the firm's sites (site dictionary R1-R3); also binary

exploratory_unvalidated: ClimateBERT H3 version tau(Y1) vs tau(Y4)
outcomes_main_a20.limitation_note: ClimateBERT outcomes were not validated against human coding; design g validation dropped by owner decision (A20)

value: Cohen kappa and F1 (model vs human)

min_alpha.citation: attributed to Krippendorff (2019) doi:10.4135/9781071878781; value not_verified from text
min_alpha.note: benchmark values to be confirmed in the original texts before the paper

min_kappa.citation: attributed to Landis & Koch 1977 doi:10.2307/2529310; value not_verified from text
min_kappa.note: benchmark values to be confirmed in the original texts before the paper

fallback.value: one pre-declared threshold recalibration on a split sample; else human-coded outcome and descriptive-only hypothesis

status_a20.value: human validation (design g) dropped by owner decision; coder, codebook and sampling keys below (A18, A19) are superseded and not used

precision_check.value: 100 snippets of hazard-tagged scored narrative paragraphs (main census), stratified by hazard term family (flood; storm; drought / water stress; heat; coastal / erosion / sea level; wildfire), equal allocation 17/17/17/17/16/16, shortfall to other families in turn; max 5 per firm, 1 per paragraph; snippet = sentence with the match +/- 1 sentence, match marked [[ ]]; one external person answers: Is the highlighted word used about a real weather/climate hazard? yes/no
precision_check.rule: precision overall and per family with Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals; overall precision < 0.80 -> H1-H3 reported as descriptive only; terms with precision < 0.50 and n >= 5 listed as a limitation (counts unchanged unless a later amendment)

coder.value: one external coder (not the project owner) codes all sampled paragraphs twice; second pass in a new random order at least 7 days after the first; the coder sees no model output and no dictionary tag
coder.reference_coding: the external coder's first pass, with disagreements resolved in that coder's second pass

codebook.value: docs/coding_guide.md (frozen before coding; SHA-256 in docs/amendments.md)

sampling.frame: data/interim/paragraphs.csv rows with model_eligible = 1 and section = narrative, from main-census firms (robustness-stratum firms excluded); the Phase 0 test document DANGCEM_2025_SRX is excluded (coding-guide examples)
sampling.strata: 6 cells: detector prediction (climate no; climate yes and specific; climate yes and non-specific, at the OD-10 thresholds of 0.5) x hazard-dictionary tag (yes / no, config/dictionary_hazard.json)
sampling.allocation: equal: 34/33/33/33/34/33 for (no,untagged)/(no,tagged)/(spec,untagged)/(spec,tagged)/(non-spec,untagged)/(non-spec,tagged); a shortfall in a cell is filled from the other cell of the same prediction class, then from any cell
sampling.caps: at most 10 paragraphs per firm; at most 10% (20) from FS-type documents; enforced while drawing (candidates in seeded random order, cells taken in turn)
sampling.predictions_use: detector and specificity models run on the frame only to form strata; stored in data/interim/validation_strata.csv, never shown to the coder, not used for any outcome
sampling.weights: inclusion weight per cell = frame cell size / sampled cell size, stored with the strata for weighted metrics

h3_listing_rule.value: for H3, a firm-year counts in the main analysis only if its fiscal year ends on or after the firm's NGX listing date; pre-listing firm-years are kept and reported as a robustness check only
h3_listing_rule.applies_to: H3 only (H1/H2 not changed by A16)
h3_listing_rule.other_firms: all other main-census firms are taken as listed before 2020-01-01 (long-standing NGX listings); not individually verified from a primary source

value.H1: primary Y4s ~ exposure (fractional logit; OLS robustness); secondary Y3d and Y4d binary
value.H2: primary Y3d; secondary Y4s; exposure vs institutional blocks as design h
value.H3: tau(Y3d) > 0 and tau(Y3d) > tau(Y4r), standardised, bootstrap interval for the difference; A16 sample rule unchanged

primary_outcomes_a20.conditional_rule: if dictionary precision overall < 0.80 (precision check, A20), H1-H3 are reported as descriptive only
primary_outcomes_a20.conditional_rule_result: A21: overall precision 30/46 = 0.65 < 0.80, so H1-H3 are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; limitations: storm (1/8), erosion (2/6); coastal (1/4, n < 5) noted; heat (n = 3) and wildfire (n = 0) not estimable

inference.citation: Cameron, Gelbach & Miller 2008 doi:10.1162/rest.90.3.414; MacKinnon & Webb 2017 doi:10.1002/jae.2508 (Crossref)

value: P5 locations/assets at physical risk identified (IFRS S2 paras 13(b), 29(c), B65(b); A24)

ifrs_s2.value: data/raw/manual/policy/issb-2026-a-ifrs-s2-climate-related-disclosures.pdf (ISSB-2026-A consolidated edition incl. Dec 2025 GHG amendments; effective for annual periods beginning on or after 1 January 2024, amendments from 1 January 2027); paragraph numbers cited only, text not quoted (personal non-commercial licence)
ifrs_s2.previous_value: pending - owner to supply before Phase 6

policy_coding.value: descriptive, analyst-coded firm-year coding of P1-P7 (design i): keyword search over all text rows of the firm-year's documents, every match read by the analyst; a code is 1 only with page evidence; no human validation

rules.P1: 1 if a passage discusses the resilience of the firm's strategy or business model to climate-related physical risks or climate hazards (FRC Roadmap PDF p23; IFRS S2 para 22)
rules.P2: 1 if a passage states that climate-related scenario analysis was used (qualitative or quantitative), e.g. named climate scenarios or warming pathways (FRC Roadmap PDF p23-24; IFRS S2 para 22)
rules.P3: 1 if a metric for climate-related physical risk is reported: an amount or percentage of assets, sites or business activities exposed or vulnerable to physical climate hazards (FRC Roadmap PDF p25; IFRS S2 para 29(c))
rules.P4: 1 if a passage states that climate-related (physical) risks are identified or managed within the firm's risk-management process (enterprise risk management, risk register, risk committee) (FRC Roadmap s7.4; IFRS S2 para 25)
rules.P6: early / voluntary / none: 'early' if the firm-year states it applies IFRS S1/S2 for a period ending on or before 31 Dec 2023; 'voluntary' if it states it applies or reports in accordance with IFRS S1/S2 for a 2024-2027 period; 'none' otherwise (statements of readiness, plans or alignment only are recorded as 'none (readiness stated)') (FRC Roadmap s6.1; SEC circular)
rules.P7: 1 if the documents refer to the NGX (or NSE) Sustainability Disclosure Guidelines

policy_coding.scope: main-census firm-years with documents, excluding NNFM FY2020 (A23); all documents of the firm-year, all sections

p5_definition.value: P5 = 1 if the firm-year's documents identify where climate-related physical risks are concentrated by geographical area, facility or type of asset (IFRS S2 para 13(b)), or report the amount or percentage of assets or business activities vulnerable to climate-related physical risks (para 29(c); para B65(b) links that metric to the concentration in 13(b)); physical risks as defined in IFRS S2 Appendix A (acute and chronic)
p5_definition.previous_value: defined from the FRC Roadmap only, pending IFRS S2
